Also, if you run the following code:

rdd <- textFile(sc, "hdfs://localhost:9000/TODO.md")
rdd1<- map(rdd, function(x) {x})
saveAsObjectFile(rdd1, "hdfs://localhost:9000/test.txt")

An additional un-nessary reserialize() is called.

The root cause is that the serialized flag in a PipelinedRDD is not set correctly. The actual flag of whether the JRDD contains serialized R objects or not is determined upon the first call to getJRDD(). By default, the JRDD of a PipelinedRDD contains serialized R objects as the dataSerialization parameter for getJRDD() by default is TRUE. So set serialized to TRUE to be consistent with this behavior.
